result.rationale: The diff shows parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts setting `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` when missing, and office365calendar CalendarService.ts spreads `...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data)` over existing credentials, so the placeholder can overwrite a stored real refresh_token, corrupting the credential. judged_text: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:279 — `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` puts a placeholder where the real value belongs, and office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:262 `{ ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }` spreads it over the stored real refresh_token whenever Microsoft or the sync endpoint leaves refresh_token out (the schema marks it `.optional()`), so the credential permanently loses its refresh token (P1, conf 75)
